messages:
Harini: Quick note from usability testing: people are confused by the small circular performance markers in the compare rows. they read color as cost, not latency.
Ben: saw that too. users expect an explicit axis. currently badge = color+icon only.
Clara: Proposal: include a 1-word axis label inside the tooltip (Latency / Throughput / Cost) and add a small non-color glyph on the badge (dot/line/star) so it survives colorblindness.
Harini: Also: when switching between tabs the active filters sometimes reset without warning. testers thought the filter vanished.
Ben: Could we persist filter sets per route in sessionStorage keyed by route+user? simple and reversible.
Clara: UX detail: if we persist, show a subtle hint in the header: "Restored filters from last session" with an undo action for 5s. helps avoid surprise.
UX-Bot: Accessibility checks: 1) All badges must have aria-label describing axis and sample metric. 2) If tooltip reveals extra text, ensure aria-describedby is set when focused. 3) Filter restore banner should use role=status and be keyboard-focusable.
Harini: For pinning, testers asked if pin is temporary or saved to account. our current tooltip says just "Pin" which is ambiguous.
Ben: Change tooltip to "Pin for compare (temporary)" and show ephemeral banner: "Pinned for this compare session" after pinning. include "Save pins to library" as a secondary action.
Clara: Design question: do we want an opt-in persistent pinning? maybe behind a small toggle in the banner: "Save pins". Might be scope creep but worth discussing.
Ben: Implementation plan: small PR to Badge and Filter components. Badge: add prop `axisLabel` and `glyph` (string). Filter: persist session state; show banner with undo. Pin: add aria-pressed + banner role=status.
Harini: Microcopy idea for badge tooltip: Title: "Performance — Latency" Body: "P95 < 50ms on our reference harness. This indicates speed; not a cost guarantee."
Ben: Code snippet for badge (rough):

```
<Badge
  glyph="dot"
  color="green"
  axisLabel="Latency"
  aria-label="Performance: latency-first; P95 under 50ms"
/>
```

Clara: For the persisted filters banner: show "Filters restored (3). Undo". use aria-live=polite and make the Undo button tabbable.
UX-Bot: Suggested tests: 1) a11y snapshot for badge focus and tooltip announcement. 2) keyboard flow for filter restore banner. 3) behavior test for pin banner and save pins action.
Infra-bot: Note: if you store sessionState in local/session storage, ensure we clear on logout and respect private browsing. add opt-out flag for sensitive customers.
Harini: Good catch. we'll add clearing on sign-out and a flag behind feature config.
Ben: Next steps: Clara to mock glyph variants + banner copy in Figma; Harini to draft microcopy for tooltips; I'll open the small PR for badge props and filter persistence.
Clara: Dropping Figma WIP: https://www.figma.com/file/NEWUI/compare-badges-filters (WIP)
Harini: Let's aim for a small unflagged rollout after a quick a11y review. thanks! :thumbsup:
